event.description: Test final projection-free feed-forward boundary at width 9
event.proposal: Family: feed-forward width. Current retained frontier is 3,040 parameters at 99.850000%, a +0.850000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 10 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0022, projection-free ff_dim=10 at 3,040 parameters and 99.85% official accuracy; the most recent failed result is attempt-0021, projection-free ff_dim=8 at 2,912 parameters and a scored 98.86% nonqualification. Hypothesis: the same-architecture capacity transition may lie at the sole remaining integer width 9; reducing ff_dim 10->9 removes 64 parameters for a 2,976-parameter model. This parameterization-preserving test is more informative than any nearest alternative in the family because it completes the exact accepted/failed projection-free bracket under identical training conditions.
